about: Visual recipes for the 16 spells (one per spell id, same order as desy/data/spells_full.json). Reference frame: 1280x720 canvas, hero ~230 px tall, feet (origin bottom-centre) at y=420. Times in ms. Positions are anchors (+ offsets as fractions of the target/hero height, "...Rel"), or screen fractions ("...Frac"). Speeds/gravity are px/s on the 1280x720 frame. "scale" multiplies the texture's on-screen size at 1280x720 (stored px x 0.667). Texture keys = fx/manifest.json textures; status keys = fx/manifest.json status. Schema: README.md.

anchors.wand_tip: hero right edge, 40% down from the hero top (hero sprite visible bounds)
anchors.above_hero: hero top-centre, offset by offsetYRel x hero height
anchors.target_center: centre of the enemy's visible body
anchors.target_head: top of the enemy's visible body
anchors.air_near_target: 0.6 target heights left of and 0.6 above the target centre
anchors.sky_upper_left_of_target: above the top edge of the screen, 0.25 screen widths left of the target
anchors.hero_front_ground: 0.3 hero heights right of the hero feet, on the ground line
anchors.targets_sweep: travels left to right through every target and exits right

paths.arc: parabola from->to, peak arcHeightRel x target height above the line
paths.falls_from_sky: diagonal down-right from the sky anchor to the target, eased in
paths.sweep: ground-level travel through all targets (impact fires as it passes each one)

reactions.shiver: fast small horizontal jitter, idle frame
reactions.lift_spin: rise liftRel x height, spin like a top (scaleX = cos), drop, optional squash
reactions.freeze: hold still with faceFrame (surprised) under the frozen overlay

flashRule: at most 1 camera flash per cast, white only, under 100 ms, never red, never more than 3 flashes per second
fizzle: none (casting is a free action; no fizzle effect)
